title: Reservation v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). One admission-ledger entry for one request, including retries and children. There is exactly one reservation authority; Core and the gateway keep no independently spendable counters. Every request carries a reservation, and missing usage remains reserved rather than being released as free. usage_status 'unknown' is retained explicitly and is never coerced to zero.

request_id.description: Gateway/native request id. Required; a request without a correlation id is not admissible.

parent_request_id.description: Empty string for a root request, otherwise the parent request id. Nested children are accounted here too.

reserved_tokens.description: Reserved tokens are held until observed usage is recorded; unknown usage stays reserved.

usage_status.description: Unknown usage is a distinct retained state, never zero.

issuer.description: Authenticated reservation authority. Not a worker-supplied string.
